info.title: Inventory Rewrite API
info.description: Backend API for the single-school inventory rewrite. Cookie-authenticated unsafe browser requests also require X-CSRF-TOKEN. Signed endpoint-agent ingress uses ECDSA machine authentication instead of cookies or browser antiforgery.

post.description:
Machine authentication: a short-lived, usage-capped enrollment profile token plus an ECDSA P-256 signature over the canonical identity request is required. Browser antiforgery does not apply.

Authentication: anonymous.
